name: foam-rolling-thoracic-spine
instructions:
1. In a supine position, position the foam roller directly underneath your upper back.
2. Pick your hips up off the floor and give yourself a large hug. Try to touch the opposite shoulder blade with your hand to free up space around the musculature surrounding your thoracic spine.
3. Adjust pressure into the roller by raising your hips higher or lower.
4. Slowly roll up and down the length of the thoracic spine for 20-30 seconds.
5. Repeat on the other side.
